actions.text: Welcome to Titan Gym. Stronger every day. How can we help you today?
actions.fallback_text: Please tap one of the buttons so I can help you faster.

actions.text: Choose the membership plan that fits your goal best.
actions.footer: Need help choosing? Our team can recommend the best option for you.
actions.fallback_text: Please choose a package from the list.

actions.text: Pick a class to see what suits your schedule and fitness level.
actions.fallback_text: Please choose a class from the list.

actions.body: Day Pass is RM15 for full-day access. To book instantly, complete the payment using the link below.
actions.pending_text: No worries, your Day Pass booking is still pending. Complete the payment, then tap Payment Success once done.
actions.receipt_text: Day Pass payment received. Receipt ID: {{receipt_id}}. Please come to Titan Gym today during operating hours, show this receipt at the counter, and our team will check you in.
actions.expired_text: Your Day Pass payment link has expired. Reply PAYMENT to get a fresh link, or type STAFF if you want help.

actions.body: Monthly Membership is RM120 with unlimited gym access for 30 days. Complete payment below to activate your membership.
actions.pending_text: Your membership payment is still pending. Complete payment first, then tap Payment Success when finished.
actions.receipt_text: Monthly Membership payment received. Receipt ID: {{receipt_id}}. Please come to Titan Gym, show this receipt at the counter, and our team will activate your 30-day membership immediately.
actions.expired_text: This membership payment link has expired. Reply PAYMENT to request a fresh payment link, or type STAFF if you want assistance.

actions.text:
You are all set ??

Please come to Titan Gym and show your receipt at the counter.

What would you like next?
actions.fallback_text: Please tap one of the options below.

actions.text: Titan Gym, Ground Floor, Kota Bharu Trade Centre. Bring your workout attire, towel, water bottle, and show your payment receipt at the counter.
We are open daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM. You can come anytime during operating hours and show your payment receipt at the counter.
If you need anything else, choose one of these options.
If payment was not completed, I can still help. Choose an option below.
actions.fallback_text: Please tap one of the options below.

actions.text: If your Day Pass payment was not completed, choose what you want to do next.
actions.fallback_text: Please tap one of the options below.

actions.text: Personal Training is available for fat loss, muscle gain, and beginner fitness. Reply with your goal and our trainer will recommend the best package for you.
Great choice. We have Zumba, Yoga, and HIIT sessions available weekly. Reply with your preferred class and time, and our staff will share the latest schedule and reserve your slot.
Sure, we will pass you to our staff. Please wait a moment while someone gets back to you.
